verdict.rationale: The evidence references a mistral.ai/pricing page and billing/usage docs, but none of the cited content actually shows or confirms a public per-token price table covering all current models — the only pricing content quoted (docs-25/33) is about relative discount percentages for cached tokens, not absolute per-token prices, and the pricing URL is cited only for licensing language, not price figures.
